children: Brazil's central bank said on Wednesday that measures under preparation in response to the growing share of high-cost credit products in household debt are aimed at ensuring the recognition of risks in a timely manner.

In the minutes of its latest Financial Stability Committee meeting, the central bank said the measures are also intended to promote "the gradual accumulation of capital, and more sustainable conditions for the provision of credit to borrowers."
